chunks: Al-Khalil ibn Ahmad al-Sejezy told me, saying: Ibn Mu'az informed us, saying: Al-Hussein al-Marvazy narrated to us, saying: Abdullah narrated to us, saying: Yahya ibn Ubaydullah informed us, saying: I heard my father saying: I heard Abu Hurayrah saying: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
A servant entered Paradise for removing a thorn from the path of the Muslims.
ai.seo_question: What small deed can lead to entering Paradise according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq cites this hadith to illustrate that even minor, sincere acts of removing obstacles from the path of others can secure entry into Paradise, emphasizing the cumulative value of small deeds in Shia spirituality. This narration underscores the concept of *sadaqah* beyond material wealth, highlighting how physical ease provided to fellow believers serves as a direct means of spiritual purification and divine reward.
